ext_messenger_templates_desc_1: Create pre-defined messages for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord.
ext_messenger_templates_desc_2: You can set a template as Default to automatically format Hecos responses.
ext_messenger_telegram_desc: Use the official Telegram API to send messages quickly and reliably. Create a bot via @BotFather.
ext_messenger_telegram_chat_id_desc: Used as a fallback if the command does not specify a recipient.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_desc_1: Hecos supports sending via both the official Desktop App and WhatsApp Web.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_option1: Install the official WhatsApp App for Windows and log in. Hecos will detect the app and send messages much faster without opening new tabs.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_option2: If the App is not installed, Hecos will automatically open a tab in your browser on WhatsApp Web. Make sure you have already scanned the QR code to keep the session active.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_use_template_desc: Forces the use of a specific template, ignoring the Default one.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_country_code_desc: Automatically added to numbers typed without a prefix (e.g., +39 for Italy).
ext_messenger_whatsapp_single_block_desc: Send multi-line texts and templates in a single message (instead of splitting into multiple continuous messages).
ext_messenger_whatsapp_cdp_timeout_desc: Max time to connect to Chrome debug port.
ext_messenger_whatsapp_worker_timeout_de: Max total time to complete the sending process.
ext_messenger_discord_desc: Send messages to a Discord server by configuring an Incoming Webhook. Does not require creating a Web Bot.
ext_messenger_discord_webhook_desc: Copy the URL from Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks.
ext_messenger_routing_desc: These system instructions tell the AI how to use the Messenger. Modify them to alter its behavior. Leave blank to use manifest defaults.
